blocks.tamil_translation: way. For they are under your control; apart from treating them well, you have no other authority over them. But if they openly commit a shameful act, leave them alone (do not sleep with them; make them stay in the house), and if necessary strike them lightly. If they obey you, do not seek (unjust) pretexts against them. Listen carefully! Just as you have rights over your wives, so your wives have rights over you. That persons whom you dislike do not come into your bedroom, and that they do not allow people whom you dislike into your house, is the duty your wives owe to you. Listen carefully! To treat your wives well in food and clothing, to make arrangements for your wives' food and clothing according to your means, is the duty you owe to your wives”. Hazrat Ahwas (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَعْطُوا اْلاَجِيْرَ اَجْرَهُ قَبْلَ اَنْ يَجِفَّ عَرَقُهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابن ماجه باب اجر الاجراء رقم: ٢٤٤٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Give the hired worker his wages before his sweat dries.”
